title: Manga 'Oshi ni Amagami' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions announced a television anime adaptation of Julietta Suzuki 's Oshi ni Amagami ( Otaku Vampire's Love Bite ) manga on Wednesday, revealing special visual (pictured) and announcement promo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Watari Sakou's Honey Trap Method Manga Ends on December 1
content: The 121st issue of Kodansha 's Ane Friend magazine revealed on Sunday that Watari Sakou 's Honeytra Method (Honey Trap Method) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on December 1. The manga's second and final compiled book volume will debut digitally on January 20.
author: ANN

title: 5 Classic 2000s English Dub Anime That Surpass the Originals
content: The 2000s was an iconic decade for anime . Along with the 1990s, the 2000s was when anime was spreading into more of the Western mainstream, and it was when many modern anime fans got their start with the medium.
author: ComicBook

title: 'I'm Running for Crown Princess, but All I Want is a Steady Paycheck!' Manga Ends
content: Seven Seas Entertainment publishes both the original light novels and the manga adaptation in English. Seven Seas describes the story: Therese, the daughter of an impoverished marquis, works hard day and night to save every penny she can just to scrape by.
author: ANN

title: Seraph of the End Manga Ends on December 4
content: The December issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine announced on Wednesday that Takaya Kagami , Yamato Yamamoto , and Daisuke Furuya 's Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign ( Owari no Seraph ) manga will end in the next issue on December 4.
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE Confirms English Dub for Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime, Reveals Series Leaving Service in November
content: HIDIVE confirmed on Tuesday that it will begin streaming an English dub for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series beginning on November 18.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s 2026 Anime of the Year May Have Just Been Decided
content: The anime returning for its second season on Crunchyroll this Fall may have just cemented its position as the platform’s Anime of the Year. With the year about to end and all the new anime scheduled for release having finally premiered, it is now a good time to start analyzing which series could take the throne.

title: I Think Gundam Wing Hasn’t Held Up After 30 Years, But It’s Still Awesome
content: A recent re-watch of Mobile Suit Gundam Wing made me remember why I loved it so much as a kid, but also why it’s aged poorly. The Toonami classic gave a lot of kids in the western world their first glimpse of Gundam suits, and the world around them.
